name: opt-landing-nine-stops
prompt: Turn this into a completely new desktop landing page for "Smart-Clearance", shown as the full web page edge to edge with no browser window. Keep only the reference's visual system: the pale sage-white background, the deep green brand colour, the amber accent, the heavy rounded grotesque display type, the clean sans interface text, white cards with thin hairline edges and soft shadows, and the nine-dot tracker. Remove the left sidebar, its menu and all of the reference's text and layout. New layout, top to bottom: 1) A thin top navigation bar across the full width: the green rounded-square S logo and the word "Smart-Clearance" at the left; the links "How it works", "Agents", "Customers", "Pricing" in the middle; a text link "Sign in" and a dark green pill button "Book a demo" at the right. 2) The first screen on the pale sage-white ground: on the left, the large dark headline "Every near-expiry carton gets a second chance." with a short line beneath, "AI agents find the best exit for short-dated stock. You say yes once.", and two buttons: green "Watch the 6-minute demo" and white "Find your workspace". On the right, one brown corrugated cardboard carton floating in mid-air, softly lit 3D render, with its soft shadow on the ground far below and a thin glowing green line rising from it like a route. 3) Down the left edge of the page runs a vertical tracker rail: nine circular stops joined by a line, labelled "Connect", "Detect", "Verify", "Value", "Decide", "Approve", "Execute", "Settle", "Report"; the first two stops are filled green and the rest are empty rings. 4) Below the first screen, the Detect stop's section begins: a heading "09:00 · Detect" and a small surreal vignette of a full moon shaped like a clock face hanging over a warehouse at dawn, beside a white card reading "1,360 packs will not sell by 18 Nov" and "−₹26,330 if destroyed" in red. Soft 3D render for the carton and the vignette; crisp flat interface for the navigation, text, buttons, rail and card; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Option: Nine stops, one carton, a floating carton beside the headline with a nine-stop rail down the page.
